hypothesis.statement: A complete semantic map can still fail at runtime through weak response, curve crosstalk, bilateral blink leakage, missing frames or presentation-profile bypass.
hypothesis.action: Drive 19 required facial cases at 0, 0.5 and 1.0 through the real presentation profile, export all resolved curve weights, and bind each of the 57 samples to a unique checksummed Looking Glass Go PNG.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Facial actuation mechanics become reproducible and measurable before separate geometry-deformation and human visual approval.

scopeBoundary: P35 verifies runtime curve actuation mechanics, not facial geometry quality
P12 still owns lip, eyelid, volume, clipping and temporal deformation diagnostics
human review still owns likeness and expression credibility at conversational distance
failureHandling: reject missing or duplicate case/weight samples
reject non-finite, out-of-range or incomplete curve traces
reject weak half/peak response, curve crosstalk and opposite-eye blink leakage
reject missing, reused, changed or non-1440x2560 PNG captures
reject P34 lineage drift and any deformation or production overclaim
decision: Only a passing 57-sample report may enter P12 deformation capture; semantic motion alone is never AAA approval.
